channel.title: TU/e Postdoc Association: upcoming events
channel.description: Upcoming events of the TU/e Postdoc Association

item.title: Talking Science 2026
item.description: Thirteen PhD, EngD and postdoc researchers pitch their own research in three minutes. Jury prizes of €750 and €500, plus a €500 audience prize. Organised by the TU/e Communication Expertise Center as part of WinTU/er Wonderland.

item.title: Winter Village Quizzmas
item.description: A Christmas quiz together with Nexus, the PhD Association. Date and details to be announced.
